Response.reasoning: The header names the dependent variable or response being measured in the model.

Habitat variables.reasoning: The header names the independent variables or predictors used in the model.

Model-averaged coefficients.reasoning: This column holds the calculated numerical coefficient value for the variable.

Standard error (adjusted).reasoning: This column provides the statistical measure of the standard error for the coefficient.

z.reasoning: This column provides the statistical measure (z-score) for the coefficient.

p.reasoning: This column provides the statistical measure (p-value) for the coefficient.

Relative importance.reasoning: This column holds the calculated numerical value representing the variable's importance.
